Title: Kunal's Day

Cast

1. Kunal - 8 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Anita - 37 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The fishermen's village - boats, nets, coconut palms
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees

Scene 1: The fishermen's village - Day

[Kunal stands in the village. Anita stands near him.]

Kunal: "Let's do something fun today."

[Waves crash against the shore.]

Kunal: "Careful!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Kunal: "Mom, look over here."

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Anita (excited): "I knew it!"

[Night falls and the stars come out.]

Anita: "Yes, of course."

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Kunal: "Okay, Mom."

Scene 3: The snowy hillside - Day

Kunal: "Let's begin."

[Snow starts to fall.]

Kunal: "Let's see."

[Kunal makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Anita: "Oh wow!"

[Kunal builds a snowman.]

Kunal: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Kunal catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Anita: "Really?"

[Kunal slides down the snowy slope.]

Kunal: "What a day to remember!"
